description: Three of neuroschema's nemar.view-digest.v1 cases, copied unchanged (member order by UTF-16 code units, string escapes, literals and nesting): the cases within what common.determinism.jcs canonicalizes, which has no floats. Each case's canonical is the RFC 8785 text and sha256 the digest of its UTF-8 bytes.

cases.name: key_order_utf16
cases.covers: Sorted by UTF-16 code units: U+1F600 (D83D DE00) before U+FF61, which code point order reverses.

cases.name: escapes
cases.covers: Only quote, backslash and U+0000 to U+001F are escaped, short forms where JSON has them; '/', U+007F, U+2028 and non-ASCII are written as UTF-8.
